description: If you are in the United States, you might see a car with a fuel efficiency rating of 50 miles per gallon. Somewhere else, you'd probably see it called 4.7 liters per 100 kilometers. Let's practice solving real world problems like this involving units! **Unit guides are here!** Power up your classroom with engaging strategies, tools, and activities from Khan Academy’s learning experts.
